newsitem.title: UK: Moody's confirms Santander Ahorro, Monetario rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Santander Ahorro, Monetario rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it confirmed the Aaa bond fund rating assigned to the Santander Ahorro (FIM), and the Aaa money market fund rating of the Superfondo Santander Monetario (FIAMM) (the Funds).
"These rating actions conclude a review initiated on February 4, 1997. The Funds are Spanish open-ended mutual funds (FIM) that are managed by Gesbansander," Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's said it reviewed the Funds in light of their recent rating action on peseta denominated bonds issued by the Kingdom of Spain.
"Due to the Funds' conservative weighted average maturity and high credit quality holdings they will be able to maintain a Aaa credit quality," the agency said.
Besides citing the Funds' well-developed trading, audit, and compliance systems, Moody's noted that Gesbansander was an experienced money manager.
